primary_claim: Synthetic document finetuning (SDF) — finetuning on LLM-generated synthetic documents referencing a proposition — succeeds at inserting all but the most implausible beliefs into LLMs across the model scales studied, with demonstrated proof-of-concept applications to unlearning (models output inserted incorrect information over prior true knowledge even when jailbroken) and honeypotting for detecting misalignment.
stated_future_work: further research needed to address technical and ethical considerations for production deployment of SDF
quote: We find that, across the model scales we study, SDF succeeds at inserting all but the most implausible facts.
